description: Adds a rendering to presentation of an item. Writes whatever it is told: use get-allowed-components-by-placeholder first, or add-rendering-to-placeholder, if the layout has to stay valid.

database.description: The context database. Sent when addressing the item or the rendering by ID -- a path carries its own database prefix (e.g. master:/sitecore/content/Home).

finalLayout.description: Specifies layout to add the rendering to. If 'true', the final layout is used, otherwise - shared layout.

id.description: The ID of the item to add the rendering to. Supply this or path.

index.description: The index at which the Rendering should be inserted.

language.description: The language version of the item to add the rendering to.

path.description: The path of the item to add the rendering to. Supply this or id.

placeHolder.description: The placeholder to add the rendering to.

renderingId.description: The ID of the rendering to add. Supply this or renderingPath.

renderingPath.description: The path of the rendering to add. Supply this or renderingId.

name: presentation-add-rendering
